docs.contenu:
🎯 Objectives
- I can name sports and hobbies.
- I can say what I like doing and what I can do.

🔍 Warm-up
Action time! Stand up and mime: swim, jump, ride a bike, read a book. Guess together! Then ask your friend: Can you swim?

📘 New words & structures
Sports: football, handball, swimming, running, tennis.
Hobbies: reading, drawing, singing, dancing, riding a bike, playing games.
Structures:
- I like playing football.
- She loves drawing.
- I can swim. He can't ride a bike.
- Can you sing? Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
- My hobby is reading.

✏️ Practice examples
1. I like playing football with my friends on Sunday.
2. Leila loves drawing animals. She draws very well.
3. I can swim, but I can't play tennis.
4. Can you ride a bike? Yes, I can!

🛠️ How to say it
To talk about hobbies:
1. Say what you like: I like / I love + action with ING. I like reading.
2. Say what you can do: I can + action. I can run fast.
3. Ask a friend: Can you...? Do you like...?

⭐ Remember
- After LIKE and LOVE, the action takes ING: I like swimmING.
- CAN = I know how to do it. CAN'T = I don't know how yet.
- Play sport and move your body: it makes you happy and strong!

🔗 Try at home
Write two lists: three things you CAN do and one thing you CAN'T do yet. Example: I can run. I can't swim yet. Practice makes perfect!

🎲 Fun corner
Talent show! Each pupil mimes something he or she can do. The class says: You can dance! You can swim! Mini-dialogue:
- Can you play football?
- Yes, I can. It is my favourite sport!
- Me too! Let's play together on Sunday.

📋 Summary
Sports include football, handball, swimming, running and tennis, while hobbies include reading, drawing, singing, dancing and riding a bike. After like and love, the action word takes ING: I like swimming, she loves drawing. We use CAN when we know how to do something (I can swim) and CAN'T when we don't know yet (He can't ride a bike). We ask Can you...? and answer Yes, I can or No, I can't. Write two lists — things you can do and one thing you can't do yet — and keep practising!

enonce.question: Choose: I like ___ football. (playing / play / plays)
Fill in: Can you swim? Yes, I ___. (can / can't / am)
Choose: She rides a ___. (bike / book / song)
Fill in: He ___ swim, but he can't play tennis. (can / like / is)
Put the words in order: drawing / loves / Leila / animals
Choose the correct sentence: (a) I like swim. (b) I like swimming.
Write two sentences: one thing you CAN do and one thing you CAN'T do.
What is your hobby? Write one sentence.
Correct the mistake: She can rides a bike.
